parts.t: Rancher-style half-duplex with NO STRATA FEES in East Abbotsford! Features 3 bedrooms, 1 bath, updated kitchen with pull-out shelving, and cozy wood-burning stove. Enjoy a fully fenced yard with new concrete patio, mature trees, and storage off the carport. Tasteful updates throughout. Walk to parks, Rec Centre, top schools, and minutes to highway & amenities.
